# AI Premium Shop

The production /llms.txt is generated during the Cloudflare public build from
the governed approved commerce projection and the final canonical sitemap.
This source-controlled file is a safe fallback ONLY; it must not enumerate
prices, shared credentials, unverified plan availability or restricted offers.

## Current Public Resources
- Main website: https://aipremiumshop.com/
- Public catalog: https://aipremiumshop.com/products
- Current pricing: https://aipremiumshop.com/pricing
- Support: https://aipremiumshop.com/contact
- How to order: https://aipremiumshop.com/how-to-order
- Sitemap: https://aipremiumshop.com/sitemap.xml

Prices and access arrangements shown on current approved product pages are
subject to exact-order verification before payment; they are not provider MSRP.
No provider reseller authorization, blanket delivery ETA or sitewide replacement
warranty is implied. Contact the seller through the verified website.
